description: A hero picture by words from Paletoo’s own premium picture library (photographs, backgrounds, textures and cut-out objects made for Paletoo; nothing is generated and no credits are spent). Puts the picture into the design’s photo frame (or a new design with an optional headline). Words describe a picture, not a text to print. When nothing in the library fits, it says so and changes nothing.

design.description: put it into this design’s biggest photo frame; none: a new design

kind.description: hero (a photo with room for words), background, texture or object (cut out); none: any

words.description: what the picture shows («steam rising from a latte at sunrise»)

name: generate_visual
title: Make a visual
